original_ai_output.title_zh: 洪水与冲突致方加克社区难以获得医疗服务
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据无国界医生组织报告，南苏丹琼莱州方加克县的社区因多年洪水、流离失所和冲突而难以获得医疗服务。居民称洪水摧毁了房屋、农田和牲畜，迫使家庭迁往高地。无国界医生表示其位于老方加克的医院于2025年5月遭空袭被毁，造成7人死亡、27人受伤。该组织于2026年2月在方加克启动社区辅助医疗项目以改善医疗可及性。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹琼莱州方加克县社区因洪水、流离失所和冲突难以获得医疗服务
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Communities in Fangak County in Jonglei State are struggling to access healthcare after years of flooding, displacement and conflict, according to a report by Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF).

key_facts.fact: 无国界医生位于老方加克的医院于2025年5月遭空袭被毁，造成7人死亡、27人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: MSF said its hospital in Old Fangak was destroyed in an aerial attack in May 2025, killing seven people and injuring 27 others.

key_facts.fact: 该医院此前服务超过11万人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The hospital had served more than 110,000 people.

key_facts.fact: 无国界医生于2026年2月在方加克启动社区辅助医疗项目，覆盖四个区域，惠及超过2.5万人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: MSF launched a community paramedicine programme in Fangak in February 2026. The programme provides basic medical care, maternal healthcare and referrals across four areas, reaching more than 25,000 people.

uncertainties: 事件信息目前仅来自单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
